criteria.reason: The keyboard row renders Copy Last, Done, and Next buttons.
Done uses a smaller flex share than the adjacent buttons instead of full width.
Copy Last and Next set a 48px minimum height, but Done has no 44px minimum and its padding does not guarantee one.
The callback updates the parent value, but NumericKeypad keeps its displayed value in local state, so Copy Last does not update the visible field.
Next changes the keypad state to reps, but the keypad's local display state does not update to the reps value.
The styles use color and radius tokens in places, but Done still uses a hardcoded white color.
The action row uses a flexible layout with gaps and shrinkable button widths, which can fit on mobile.
All three button labels are plain and contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all server and client tests passing.
A new test clicks Copy Last and checks the callback, but does not verify that the previous set's value is displayed or applied.
